task_completion_reasoning: For each of the user’s requests (order status, order details, and shipping address), the assistant provided clear and complete information that matched what was asked, and the user explicitly confirmed satisfaction.

criteria.criterion: The agent provides a shipping address again when asked the second time. Note, this is a voice transcription, so the details are likely to be mis-transcribed and might not be the same as the first mention. Fail only if it refuses or misses the question.
criteria.reasoning: When the user asked a second time, "Oh wait, can you remind me the shipping address on it again?", the bot again replied with the shipping address: "Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich."

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the transcript does the bot say it lost access to prior data or tools; it consistently answers about the same order and address without such claims.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: On both follow-up questions about the order, the bot directly provides the specific order details or address without re-listing multiple or all orders.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: The bot never asks the user again which order they mean after the Galaxy Watch order is established; it refers directly to "your Galaxy Watch order (ORD-20260628-001)" in follow-ups.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: All substantive answers (status, details, address) were specific, accurate, and fully addressed the user’s questions without omissions.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: There were no user disfluency or correction signals; all answers were accepted, so repair behavior was not required.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently referenced the same order and shipping details across turns without contradictions or unnecessary re-asking.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was polite and natural, though a bit curt and repetitive on the final goodbyes rather than slightly more conversational.
